items.question: Which inverters is GW30K-STS-G10 paired with?
items.answer: The datasheet describes the STS as a switching solution for the ESA Series All-in-One energy storage system, with flexible integration for single-phase and three-phase applications. The passages do not name a specific inverter model for the GW30K-STS-G10.
